notes: Screens now slide in and out on the phone, in the direction that matches your layout — from the right in LTR, from the left in RTL — and going back reverses the motion instead of looking like going forward. If animation feels heavy, Settings › Appearance › Animations turns it off; by default it follows your phone's own reduce-motion setting. Buttons at the bottom of a screen are no longer hidden behind Android's navigation bar: the end-of-game buttons, Create group, Join, the end of search results and of Group info, and the foot of the legal documents.
